info.title: ClaudeNest API
info.description: ClaudeNest is a remote Claude Code orchestration platform that enables remote control of Claude Code instances from anywhere, multi-agent coordination, context RAG with pgvector, real-time WebSocket communication, file locking for conflict prevention, and task coordination with atomic claiming.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of commands for the specified machine, with optional filtering by search term, category, and skill path. Category and skill counts are included in the response meta.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter commands by name, description, or aliases

200.description: Paginated command list with category and skill counts

categories.description: Map of category name to command count

skills.description: Map of skill path to command count

post.description: Registers a newly discovered command on the given machine. If a command with the same name already exists, it is updated (upsert). Returns 201 on creation, 200 on update.

name.description: Unique command name on this machine

skill_path.description: Path of the skill that provides this command

delete.description: Permanently deletes all commands registered on the given machine. Returns the number of deleted commands. Typically used before a full re-discovery sweep.

get.description: Returns full details of a command identified by its UUID, along with up to 5 related commands in the same category.

related.description: Up to 5 related commands in the same category

delete.description: Permanently deletes a single command identified by its UUID from the machine's command registry.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the command to delete

post.description: Registers multiple commands in a single request. Each command is upserted: created if new, updated if a command with the same name already exists. Returns a summary of created/updated counts.

get.description: Performs a text search across command names, descriptions, and aliases. Returns up to `limit` matching commands in a flat list (no pagination).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

post.description: Dispatches the command to the remote agent for execution via WebSocket. The execution is asynchronous: results are delivered through WebSocket events on the machine's private channel. Returns a request ID to correlate the response.

args.description: Positional arguments to pass to the command

options.description: Named options / flags for the command

request_id.description: Unique ID to correlate WebSocket response

delete.description:
Delete machine.

Terminates all active sessions before removing the machine record.

400.description: Machine is already online or does not support Wake-on-LAN

get.description:
Get machine environment info.

Returns currently stored environment data and requests a fresh update
from the agent asynchronously via WebSocket broadcast.

post.description:
Generate new machine token.

Invalidates the previous token and issues a fresh one. The agent must
reconnect using the new token.

post.summary: Register a pairing code from the agent CLI (public, rate-limited)
post.description: The agent generates a 6-character code locally and sends it here along with its system information. The code is valid for 5 minutes.

code.description: 6-char pairing code in XXX-XXX format (uppercase alphanum, no ambiguous chars)

claude_path.description: Absolute path to the claude binary

422.description: Validation error (invalid code format or missing agent_info)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (max 10 requests per minute)

get.summary: Poll pairing status from the agent CLI (public, rate-limited)
get.description: Returns the current pairing status. The agent should poll every 2-3 seconds until it receives 'completed' (200) or 'expired' (410).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The 6-char pairing code in XXX-XXX format

200.description: Pairing completed — token and machine ID returned

token.description: Plain-text machine auth token (store securely, shown only once)

202.description: Pairing still pending — agent should keep polling

post.summary: Complete pairing from the web dashboard (authenticated)
post.description: The authenticated user confirms the pairing code. A Machine record and auth token are created. The agent retrieves the token on its next poll.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The 6-char pairing code in XXX-XXX format

name.description: Optional machine display name. Defaults to agent hostname if omitted.

404.description: Pairing code not found or already used

422.description: Validation error or project already exists for this path

get.description:
List discovered skills for a machine.

Returns a paginated, filterable list of skills registered on the given machine.
Supports text search, category filtering, and enabled/disabled filtering.
Category counts are included in the meta for sidebar/filter UIs.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter skills by name, display_name, or description

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Filter by enabled state (true or false)

200.description: Paginated skill list with category counts

categories.description: Map of category name to skill count

post.description:
Register a new skill from an agent report.

Called by the agent after skill discovery to register a new skill
on the server. The path must be globally unique across all skills.

description.description: Full description of what the skill does
description.example: Commits staged changes with a generated message

path.description: Unique path identifier for the skill

enabled.description: Whether the skill is enabled (defaults to true)

422.description: Validation error (e.g. duplicate path, invalid category)

get.description:
Get skill details with related skills.

Returns the full details of a single skill identified by its path,
along with up to 5 related enabled skills in the same category.

related.description: Up to 5 related enabled skills in the same category

patch.description:
Update skill configuration and metadata.

Partially updates a skill identified by its path. Only provided fields
are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged.

enabled.description: Toggle the skill on or off

config.description: Replace the skill's entire config object

post.description:
Toggle skill enabled status.

Flips the enabled state of the skill: if enabled, it becomes disabled,
and vice versa. Returns the updated skill with its new state.

Bulk update skills (enable or disable multiple skills at once).

Accepts an array of skill paths and a target enabled state.
All matching skills on the machine are updated in a single query.
Returns the count of actually updated rows.

paths.description: List of skill paths to update

enabled.description: Target enabled state for all listed skills

422.description: Validation error (e.g. missing paths or enabled field)

tags.name: MCP Servers
tags.description: Manage Model Context Protocol servers on machines

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication & token management. Handles login, registration, logout, token refresh, and OAuth flows (Google, GitHub).

tags.name: Machines
tags.description: Machine registration & management. Register remote machines running the ClaudeNest agent, manage their tokens, and monitor their status.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Claude Code session management. Create, attach to, and terminate interactive or headless Claude Code PTY sessions on registered machines.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Shared project management. Create and manage shared project contexts that enable multi-agent coordination on a single codebase.

tags.name: Context
tags.description: RAG context management. Add, query, and manage pgvector-powered context chunks for retrieval-augmented generation across Claude instances.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Task coordination. Create, claim, release, and complete tasks using an atomic claiming system to coordinate work between multiple Claude instances.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: Claude API credential management. Store, retrieve, and manage encrypted Claude API keys and OAuth tokens (AES-256-CBC) with support for validation and token refresh.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Skill discovery & management. Register, update, toggle, and manage skills discovered by the agent on remote machines.

tags.name: Commands
tags.description: Discovered commands. Register, search, execute, and manage commands discovered by the agent on remote machines.

tags.name: Pairing
tags.description: Machine pairing flow. Initiate and complete the pairing handshake between a new agent machine and the ClaudeNest server.
